metadata.description: Likely represents the domain for cookies used in the UI.
metadata.requirements: Should be a valid domain string or left empty if cookies are not domain-specific.

suggestions: Provide a valid domain if cookies need to be scoped to a specific domain.
If left empty intentionally, ensure downstream systems can handle it.

metadata.description: Likely represents the name of the cookie used in the UI.
metadata.requirements: Should be a valid cookie name or left empty if cookies are not used.

suggestions: Provide a unique and descriptive cookie name.
If left empty intentionally, ensure downstream systems can handle it.

metadata.description: Specifies the login type or authentication provider used in the UI.
metadata.requirements: Should match one of the supported login types.

suggestions: Ensure 'okta' is correctly configured in the authentication system.
Document all supported login types for consistency.

metadata.description: Represents a password for the site or application.
metadata.security_risks: Passwords should always be stored securely and never hardcoded or exposed as plaintext.
metadata.requirements: Should be kept secret and follow secure password practices.

suggestions: Store this value securely in a secrets management system.
Avoid hardcoding sensitive information in environment variables.
Rotate passwords periodically and enforce complexity rules.

metadata.description: Represents a username, likely in the form of an email address.
metadata.security_risks: Email addresses can be considered sensitive if tied to user accounts or authentication.
metadata.requirements: Should be valid and protected if used for sensitive purposes.

suggestions: Store this value securely if it is tied to a sensitive account.
Consider using a service account or non-personal email for automation.
Document its purpose and access restrictions clearly.
